value.description: The numeric Shopify order id of the order whose delivery should be rescheduled (the trailing number of the order GID, e.g. 5678901234567 for gid://shopify/Order/5678901234567).

order_name.description: The order number as shown in the admin, including the leading hash (e.g. "#4111"). Filters the orders list so the order is in view when the panel opens.
